# german fixture source

`de.jsonl` contains the first German records for `Haus`, `schön`, and `Straße` from [Kaikki's German extract of English Wiktionary](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/German/kaikki.org-dictionary-German.jsonl.gz), downloaded on 12 October 2026. The extract was produced on 3 October from the 2 September 2026 dump. Only headwords, language, parts of speech, glosses, and lexical relations were retained; other metadata was removed. Text is otherwise unchanged.

Text by Wiktionary contributors, extracted by Wiktextract and distributed by Kaikki.org. Used under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), as offered by [Wiktionary's copyright statement](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights). Original entries and contributor histories: [Haus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Haus#German), [Haus history](https://en.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=Haus&action=history), [schön](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sch%C3%B6n#German), [schön history](https://en.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=sch%C3%B6n&action=history), [Straße](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Stra%C3%9Fe#German), [Straße history](https://en.wiktionary.org/w/index.php?title=Stra%C3%9Fe&action=history).
